statement: DRAM and NAND bit demand growth is expected to exceed bit supply growth by more than 10 percentage points next year.
why: A double-digit gap between memory demand and supply growth points to physical allocation limits on how many AI accelerator systems can ship.

impact.mechanism: When bit demand outruns bit supply, memory is rationed and accelerator system build rates are capped by memory availability.

evidence.excerpt: bit-based demand growth for DRAM and NAND is expected to exceed supply by more than 10 percentage points next year

confidence.basis: Forward forecast relayed by one secondary outlet; stated as a floor of more than 10 points, not a point estimate.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: Seoul Economic Daily (en.sedaily.com)
